mobsthinknow.config.title: Mobs Think Now Configuration
mobsthinknow.config.sunlight_survival.to: Any burning zombie seeks reachable water and requests squad water support; daylight exposure also triggers shade seeking. Only the daylight-only state yields to a recent attack.
mobsthinknow.config.smart_traversal.tool: Reject open doors, gates, and trapdoors whose real collision no longer supports footing, and physically jump a one-block gap toward a target when the landing is safe.
mobsthinknow.config.maximum_coordinated_: Allowed range: 4-100. Higher values increase coordination and vanilla pathfinding costs.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_visual_effects: Briefing call-and-response chatter, the leader's golden aura, role-colored deployment trails and the engage war cry.
mobsthinknow.config.squad_role_name_tags: Shows a colored role suffix above squad members while they are grouped; original names are restored when they leave.
mobsthinknow.config.individual_traits.to: Newly spawned zombies receive varied speed, maximum health, attack damage, and follow range. Higher difficulties raise the averages. Stable individual voices are always enabled as presentation.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_tactics.tool: A zombie retreats when an attack leaves it at 20% health or less, or removes 30% of its maximum health in one hit; it re-engages upon reaching safe distance or its hard time limit.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_heavy_hit_th: Retreat when one hit removes this percentage of maximum health. Uses final health lost after armor, enchantments, absorption, and shield blocking.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_maximum_seco: A hard limit measured from retreat start. Further hits update the escape direction but never extend this deadline.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_safe_distanc: End the retreat early once horizontal distance from the current attacker reaches this value; default is 5 blocks.
mobsthinknow.config.retreat_speed_percen: Path speed relative to normal movement. Defaults to 150% for a more decisive disengage.
mobsthinknow.config.food_scavenging.tool: Medium- and high-intelligence zombies below half health may seek reachable food within 12 blocks, eat one serving, and heal by its nutrition value.
mobsthinknow.config.food_minimum_intelli: Only zombies at or above this intelligence can scavenge. Default: 6. Smarter zombies act on each search opportunity more often.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_tactics.tool: Smart zombies visibly mine basic soft blocks, then pillar one block at a time against iron golems or elevated targets. This always respects mobGriefing.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_minimum_inte: Only regular zombies at or above this intelligence can gather and pillar. Default: 8.
mobsthinknow.config.terrain_block_invent: Maximum hidden building-block stack, from 3 to 16. Default: 8. Remaining blocks drop on death.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_skills.tool: A small share of eligible smart zombies become engineers, while water- and lava-bucket variants join the same profession automatically. After each skill, they wait 6-10 seconds before selecting an available TNT, water, lava, or direct-ignition action.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_spawn_chanc: Default: 8% among adult, high-intelligence, empty-handed candidates without an air-assault profession. Water- and lava-bucket variants become engineers automatically. Effective odds scale slightly with difficulty.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_tnt_skill.t: Allows engineers to place and ignite TNT at a safe cell near the target, then withdraw. Sites near allied zombies are rejected, and both mobGriefing and tntExplodes are respected.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_fluid_skill: Lets every engineer temporarily use water and lava buckets near a target, withdraw, then return to recover the real source block. Respects mobGriefing.
mobsthinknow.config.engineer_ignition_sk: Lets engineers approach a target that is not burning and ignite it for five seconds after a short visible flint-and-steel windup.
mobsthinknow.config.armed_squads.tooltip: Off by default. Raises weapon-carry odds with difficulty and may produce sword or axe zombies with shields.
mobsthinknow.config.weapon_combat_tactic: All sword and axe zombies respect the item's attack-speed cooldown and circle their target while waiting. Axemen attempt falling leap attacks when space permits; swordsmen use normal strikes.
mobsthinknow.config.spear_air_assault.to: Naturally spawned spear zombies receive an elytra and 16-64 rockets. They launch nearly vertically, use 1-2 rockets during each short orbit, and enter a spear dive before the 3.6-second hard deadline. They keep their normal ground pose without a target.
mobsthinknow.config.special_equipment.to: Allows empty-handed adult zombies to spawn with fluid buckets. Water carriers always wear Depth Strider III boots. This is independent from the experimental Armed Squads toggle.
mobsthinknow.config.fluid_tactics.toolti: Water carriers reliably screen their retreats and pour water at burning squadmates' feet; lava carriers deploy under their current target. Both use vanilla bucket sounds and recover their source.
Default: 4%. The effective chance rises slightly with world and regional difficulty.
mobsthinknow.config.lava_bucket_chance.t: Default: 2%. Lava carriers skip cells occupied by friendly zombies and try adjacent positions.
mobsthinknow.config.special_equipment_dr: Default: 85 per mille (8.5%), exactly matching the vanilla Mob equipment-slot chance. Applies to newly spawned carriers.
mobsthinknow.config.server_authority_not: This screen directly affects only singleplayer and locally hosted servers. For a dedicated server, edit its config and run /mtn reload.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all.success: Spawned %s tactical zombie archetypes in a 3x3 formation; behavior still follows the current configuration.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all.peaceful: Peaceful difficulty removes hostile mobs; switch difficulty before using this command.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all.no_space: No nearby ground has enough safe space for the complete 3x3 zombie formation.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all.create_fa: Zombie entity creation failed; no showcase formation was added.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn_all.add_faile: Adding the formation to the world failed; this spawn attempt was rolled back.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn.types: Available tactical zombie types (usage: /mtn spawn <type> [count], count 1-%s): %s
mobsthinknow.command.spawn.no_space: No safe nearby ground was found for all %s requested zombies; nothing was spawned.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn.create_failed: Preparing the requested batch of %s zombies failed; nothing was spawned.
mobsthinknow.command.spawn.add_failed: Adding the requested batch of %s zombies failed; the entire batch was rolled back.
mobsthinknow.config.spear_rocket_efficie: 100% matches vanilla attached fireworks; default 50%. Stable boost speed is about half vanilla, which also lowers kinetic spear damage. Each launched rocket synchronizes this value to clients.
